attempts.text:
**The window starts on a three-column spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `cutA`, `dsbD` and `dicD`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and 0 to 1% of calls there are in a region of plasticity. The model names 95 to 99% of them, fewest at `dsbD` (95%), and no column here hesitates more than 0.10 bits.

**Then the graph opens for 77 columns.** Columns 3 to 79 are fork and variable columns, with 12 to 93% of calls in a region of plasticity. The model names 43 to 93% of genes there (mean 85%) and hesitates most at column 3, `cadC`, 2.48 bits, in a region of plasticity in 93% of calls. At column 4, `cadB`, 1.68 bits, also 93%.

**The `cad` and `dcu` genes follow**, columns 4 to 8, variable, carried by 85 to 86% of chromosomes: `cadB`, `cadA`, `dtpC`, `lysS` and `ghoT`, [[cadaverine and lysine transport]]. A fork at column 9 carries `ghoS`, [[type V toxin-antitoxin]], persistent in 86%, beside an IS1-like element transposase in 34%. Columns 10 to 32 are variable, 60 to 88%, and hold the `dcu` and `mel` genes, [[C4-dicarboxylate transport]] and [[alpha-galactoside catabolism]], with `melB` the fewest named at column 20, 43%.

**The `phn` genes run through forks and variable columns**, 33 to 44, carried by 73 to 77%: `phnD` to `phnP`, [[phosphonate catabolism]], with `phnE` in 58% and `phnP` in 73%. The `als` genes, columns 47 to 52, [[D-allose utilization]], are carried by 50 to 53%. Two branches run parallel: 3 families through columns 47 to 49 and 6 through columns 53 to 58, each 12 to 19%, shell. The window ends at column 79, `uvrA`, in 44% of chromosomes.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 1.80 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 67% against 94%; 13,400 of 43,120 calls are inside one. Across the window it names 86% of genes at 0.70 bits on average.

label: cutA
facts:
WINDOW: the cutA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cutA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,983 to 4,062 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cutA once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 86% of genes, 0.70 bits on average (perplexity 2.1 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 28,080 calls, named 95%, 0.17 bits; shell 13,580 calls, named 74%, 1.43 bits; cloud 1,460 calls, named 14%, 4.17 bits. Outside an RGP 29,720 calls, named 94%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 13,400 calls, named 67%, 1.80 bits. Columns: 3 spine, 21 fork, 56 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.80 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (67% against 94%); 13,400 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 (cadC) 2.48 bits, RGP 93%; column 4 (cadB) 1.68 bits, RGP 93%; column 17 (melB) 1.36 bits, RGP 30%. The 14 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 84%, 0.95 bits on average; the other 66 columns: named 86%, 0.65 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 3-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 12-93%; the least: columns 0-2 (spine), RGP 0-1%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0-1%. Genes: cutA, dsbD, dicD. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 1 (dsbD), named 95%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.10 bits (column 1 (dsbD)).
2. columns 3-79 (77 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 12-93%. named 43-93% (mean 85%), fewest named at column 20, named 43%; most hesitant at column 3, 2.48 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 47-49, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 12-14%, all S; the branch's families: "YfjP family GTPase", "hypothetical protein", "DUF905 family protein"
   a second branch of 6 families through columns 53-58, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 12-19%, all S; the branch's families: yeeT, cbeA, cbtA, "DUF5983 family protein", "DUF957 domain-containing protein", "hypothetical protein"
